_comment: Edit this file to run the Danny's apps page. When the apps are in the stores, paste the store links into ios and android and set status to 'live'. price is shown as written. The unlock is a yearly auto-renewing subscription.

apps.name: World Facts
apps.tagline: Every people and country on Earth, with a fun fact, something special, and the famous people from there.
apps.priceNote: Yearly. Cancel anytime in your phone settings. No ads.
features: Free to download. Search all 219 countries and 36 peoples.
A fun fact, something special, and the five best-known people from each country
